notes: Prototype test encounter: the party and 4 Klingons on a 32 x 24 starship deck.

Rooms: Main Engineering (top left, warp core in the middle), Cargo Bay (top right, where the Klingons board), a corridor across the middle, and Crew Quarters (party start), Transporter Room and Storage along the bottom. Rooms connect through 2-tile doorways.
Map legend: '#' wall (blocks movement and line of fire), 'c' cover object (consoles, crates, tables: blocks movement, not line of fire; standing next to it gives cover automatically), '.' floor.
Positions are [x, y] with x = column and y = row. The objective text and room layout are placeholder content.
autoCombat.playerInjuryMode: the setting AI-controlled player characters use in Auto Combat. Designer spec: 'stun' (Starfleet default); 'deadly' only if set here explicitly.
